prose: Google published a Gemini Notebook API: a REST interface to create and manage notebooks and sources in Gemini Notebook. Developers can ingest web pages, YouTube videos, plain text and Markdown into persistent notebooks. The docs show creating a notebook with a display name and adding a source such as a web URL, with Bearer auth and a project header, and suggest copying a setup prompt into your coding agent.
highlights: REST API for creating and managing Gemini Notebook notebooks and sources
Sources: web pages, YouTube, text and Markdown
Docs include a quickstart prompt for coding agents
